== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Exposure (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Exposure (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): the whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
